entities.summary: Hao Peng is a Chinese politician and business executive. He served as the Party Secretary of Liaoning between 2022 and 2025, the governor of Qinghai between 2013 and 2016, and prior to that, a vice chairman of Tibet Autonomous Region. He additionally served as the chairman of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) between 2019 and 2023.
